data.name: Ashirwad
data.long_meaning: Ashirwad is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'ashirwadh', meaning 'blessing' or 'favor'. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that the gods bestow blessings upon those named Ashirwad. This name is often given to a child as a sign of hope for a prosperous and blessed life.

in_sanskrit.name: अशीर्वाद
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who bestows auspicious blessings, adorns the head with sacred thread, performs the yajña (sacred fire ritual) and performs the vāgdarśana (divine vision).

in_hindi.name: अशिर्वाद
in_hindi.meaning: पूजारी के हाथ से मिला शिरोमण्डल, यज्ञ के साथ दिया गया शिरोवाग्दर्शन
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who receives the sacred thread from the pujārī (priest) during a yajña (sacred fire ritual) and receives the divine vision.

in_tamil.name: அशிர்வாத்
in_tamil.meaning: ஆழ்வார்களிடம் அவர்கள் வீடுக்கல்லிருந்தவன், யாஜ்ஞில் இன்று அவர்கள் வாழ்த்தியவும்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is honored by the āṟvār (priests) and is present during the yajñam (sacred fire ritual).

in_telugu.name: అశీర్వాద్
in_telugu.meaning: పూజీయ హాట్టోపేటియ శిరోధరేపోపోయిందేయేళ్లేదు, యజ్ఞినేదే అయ్యేదే అవర్కోపేటియ శిరోవాగ్ధార్శణము
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who wears the sacred thread on the head bestowed by the pūjī (priest) during the yajñam (sacred fire ritual).
